concepts.name: 理想流水线性能

evidence.quote:
¡ Perfect Pipeline
¡ One instruction completes per cycle after filling 
the pipeline.
¡ No bubbles and maximum throughput.
¡ For N instructions and M stages:
¡ Total Cycles = M + N – 1
¡ Average throughput
= N / (M + N - 1) instructions per cycle
¡ Instruction throughput per second                    
Frequency * N / (M + N - 1)

¡ Could be 256 * 6 blocks

Scheduling by the warp scheduler within a SM.

evidence.quote:

Warp Execution

concepts.name: 分支分歧
facts: 同一 warp 内线程走不同执行路径
部分线程执行会降低 SIMD 利用率

evidence.quote:
GPU: Optimize Throughput of a Large Number of Simple Threads
¡ A GPU uses a SIMD pipeline to save area on 
control logic
¡
Groups scalar threads into warps
¡ Branch Divergence
¡
Occurs when threads inside warps branch to 
different execution path
¡ Result: Only a subset of threads execute, 
waste SIMD pipeline utilization
Issue of SIMD Utilization: Control Divergence

concepts.name: 原子操作
facts: 并发更新同一内存位置需要原子性等正确同步

evidence.quote:
GPU: Optimize Throughput of a Large Number of Simple Threads
¡ Atomic operations are required when threads update the value of the same memory location
¡
CUDA: int atomicAdd (int*, int);
¡ Atomic conflicts: the number of threads in a warp that update the same memory position
Issue of SIMD Utilization: Atomic Operations

concepts.name: 互斥锁
facts: 保护共享状态的临界区串行访问
锁竞争会产生代价

evidence.quote:
CPU Multicore Programming: pThread
¡ Mutex pattern:
Mutex: Protect Shared State
pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
sum += local_sum;
pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
¡ The Mutex provides:
¡ Serialized access to critical section 
¡ Race avoidance for protected 
shared state 
¡ Cost: Lock contention
Only one thread holds the mutex; others wait and the protected region is serialized

concepts.name: 块内同步
facts: __syncthreads 作用域是一个 CUDA block
可用于共享内存装载后的线程协调

evidence.quote:
GPU Programming: CUDA
¡ __syncthreads()
¡ Scope: One CUDA block
¡ Use: Tile coordination in the shared 
memory.
¡ Kernel boundary
¡ Scope: Whole threads
¡ Use: Global phase between kernels
¡ Achieved by launching separate kernels
CUDA Synchronization 
__shared__ float tile[256];
tile[threadIdx.x] = A[i];
__syncthreads();
use(tile);
¡ Load data from global memory to shared memory.
¡ Wait until all threads in the block complete the 
shared-memory load.

concepts.name: Amdahl 定律
facts: 固定问题规模时 S(p)=1/((1-f)+f/p)
f 为可并行比例
串行部分限制最大加速比

evidence.quote:
Performance Models
¡ When problem size is fixed, even a small serial fraction caps total speedup
Amdahl's Law: The Serial Fraction Wins
S(p) = 1 / ((1 - f) + f / p)
f: parallelizable fraction
1 - f: serial fraction
p: number of processors / threads
NUMERICAL INTUITION
f = 0.90
max speedup -> 10x
f = 0.99
max speedup -> 100x
FIXED PROBLEM SIZE
serial
parallelizable work
More processors squeeze the blue part, but 
the purple serial part remains.

峰值不保证实际性能

evidence.quote:

¡
Memory wall: how much computation it performs for each byte moved.

Roofline Model: Compute-Bound or Memory-Bound?
Roofline Model
Arithmetic Intensity = FLOPs / Bytes moved from memory
Why peak is hard
•
memory-bound: limited by bandwidth x 
intensity
•
compute-bound: still needs vectorization, 
tensor cores, occupancy
•
real ceilings fall with poor locality or pipeline 
utilization
